correctness.rationale: Barycentric facet gradients give the exact previously known Euclidean surface objective in original coordinates. The second directional derivative of each positive exponential edge norm admits an explicit strictly positive weighted Cauchy lower bound, forcing full Hessian positivity. The log-product constraint is closed and the objective is coercive, hence a unique global minimizer exists. Euler homogeneity yields exactly the proposed KKT system; reversal uniqueness and a strict first-vs-second derivative inequality force long ends for every n>=3. Direct algebra gives the n=3 sqrt(5)/2 ratio. Exact-rational Gram checking passed 900 weight profiles across dimensions 2--5; numerical KKT diagnostics passed dimensions 2--12. Finite tests corroborate, not prove, the global theorem.
